verdict.rationale: The evidence shows general research building blocks: uploading many sources, grounded chat with citations, selecting subsets of sources, custom report types, and saving tables to notes or exporting them to Sheets. Nothing documents a systematic screening or extraction workflow that applies consistent inclusion/exclusion or extraction criteria across each paper. Ad-hoc chat prompts and custom reports are adjacent features a user could adapt, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can run a systematic screening and extraction workflow across many papers with consistent criteria
